utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and when should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help however I can with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—thanks for keeping track, Opal. Where should we start the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—let’s start with the most urgent fixes first, and I can bring a few tools to help. Just tell me what you need most.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We still need to sort the tools and get the flyers out, then we can start Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Kira, sorry I’m late — did I miss the repair drive details?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m in. Tell me when and where the repair drive is, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — let’s start with the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Jules — that’s great to hear. I’ll ask you to help spread the word and rally a few more neighbors for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the exact issue and where the repair drive is headed? I want to make sure I have the details right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Rey said they can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it low-key today. Just point me to the simplest task, and I’ll do that.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still happening today — I heard folks are meeting up later this afternoon. I’ll pass along if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you send me the time and exact spot when you know it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — I’ll let you know the first things we’re short on for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday morning at the community center on Oak Street works for me, but I’d still like to know the schedule and what comes first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, then let’s stick with Saturday morning and meet at the community center on Oak Street first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — Saturday morning at the community center on Oak Street works for me.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Faye — if you hear the details, I’d really appreciate the update. It does sound like it could be helpful for the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll keep it simple and pass along any details I hear.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still not totally sure on the exact issue, but I can check and get back to you. The repair drive is headed to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—community center makes sense. Let me know if you find the time and details.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
